ScenarioDef.label: The Beginning
ScenarioDef.description:
They wake in a garden that isn't theirs, on a world that was old long before they arrived. Somewhere out there are settlements, roads, ruins - people with names for things they've never seen. None of that reaches here.

They remember nothing of before. No language but what they invent between themselves, no tools, no walls, no gate - nothing to say what waits past the treeline.

Everything that will ever exist for them starts now.

Warning: You start without the ability to do basic tasks, such as sowing, doctoring, and hunting - it is extremely difficult.

scenario.summary: Two people with no memory and nothing to their name, alone in a world that's already old.
